classification.difficultyReason: Complete the supplied tree while excluding the initial vowel from the last position, then filter complete words by alphabetical order and absence of O.

content.prompt:
A three-letter word is chosen in the following way:
The first and last letters are chosen from the three vowels ‘A’, ‘O’ and ‘U’, with no repetition, and the middle letter is chosen from ‘L’ and ‘M’.

inlines.text: Fill in the tree diagram. Record the missing letters and outcomes in the completion columns, following the branches from top to bottom.

spec.description: Left-to-right three-stage tree with supplied first letters A, O, U and twelve terminal branches. Missing second and third letters and outcomes are editable native clozes in adjacent completion columns, ordered to correspond to the terminal paths.
spec.mathematics: Three first-letter choices, two middle-letter choices and two last-letter choices excluding the first vowel; twelve outcomes.
spec.answerVisibility: Only A, O and U are supplied in the question diagram. All missing labels and outcomes remain hidden cloze responses.

answer.short: ALO, ALU, AMO, AMU; OLA, OLU, OMA, OMU; ULA, ULO, UMA, UMO.
answer.worked:
For each first letter, the middle branches are L and M. The last branches are the two vowels different from the first letter.

A: ALO, ALU, AMO, AMU.

O: OLA, OLU, OMA, OMU.

U: ULA, ULO, UMA, UMO.

$3\times2\times2=12$ outcomes.

The letters are in alphabetical order in ALO, ALU, AMO and AMU.

$\begin{aligned}P(\text{alphabetical order})&=\frac{4}{12}\\&=\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}$

The outcomes with no O are ALU, AMU, ULA and UMA.

$\begin{aligned}P(\text{no O})&=\frac{4}{12}\\&=\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}$
